attributes.title: 2027 TDA Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 2027 TDA Meeting runs May 13 to 15, 2027, at the Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center in downtown San Antonio. Education runs all three days; the exhibit hall is open May 13 and 14, and the House of Delegates meets May 14 and 15. The meeting is aimed at the whole dental team: dentists, residents, hygienists, assistants and office staff.

Registration opens January 20, 2027. The lowest fees apply through February 28, a pre-registration tier runs March 1 to 31, and full prices apply from April 1. The fee amounts, hotel blocks and the course list have not been published yet.

The TDA assigns CE credit at one credit hour per hour of instruction and classifies courses by the categories used by the Texas State Board of Dental Examiners. Attendees record completion codes announced at the end of each course and print their own CE transcript.
